# Third-party notices

The shared assets retain their original data:

- `include/IconsFontAwesome6.h` was generated by [IconFontCppHeaders](https://github.com/juliettef/IconFontCppHeaders) for Font Awesome 6. See [its license](licenses/IconFontCppHeaders.txt).
- `examples/assets/fa-solid-900.h` contains the compressed Font Awesome Free solid font previously bundled in both demos. The font uses SIL OFL 1.1; see [Font Awesome's notices](licenses/FontAwesome.txt).
- The retained demo programs and the SDL3 demo's graphics helpers derive from Dear ImGui examples. Their MIT notice is preserved in [DearImGui.txt](licenses/DearImGui.txt). Downloaded Dear ImGui sources also contain their upstream `LICENSE.txt`.
- SDL3's downloaded source contains its upstream `LICENSE.txt`.

Dependency versions and archive hashes are in [Dependencies.cmake](../cmake/Dependencies.cmake). Only standalone builds fetch dependencies; applications using the notification headers supply their own Dear ImGui.
